description: This file implements a feature flag synchronization mechanism for Mattermost, utilizing the Split.io client to fetch and update feature flags based on server ID and attributes. It defines SyncParams and Synchronizer classes, handles external dependencies, and provides methods for initialization, readiness check, updating feature flags, and cleanup.

classes.name: SyncParams
classes.description: Holds parameters for synchronizing feature flags, including server ID, split key, interval, logger, and attributes.

classes.name: Synchronizer
classes.description: Manages feature flag synchronization using the Split.io client, including initialization, readiness, updating flags, and cleanup.

methods.name: NewSynchronizer
methods.description: Creates a new Synchronizer instance with provided parameters, initializing the Split.io client.

methods.name: EnsureReady
methods.description: Blocks until the Split.io client is ready to provide feature flag data.

methods.name: UpdateFeatureFlagValues
methods.description: Fetches current feature flag treatments and updates the feature flags accordingly.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Destroys the Split.io client and cleans up resources.
